then.$comment: A deploy step without runtime readback makes attestation impossible; verification would run against an unverified runtime.

run.description: Registered shell command template. Placeholders ({agent_ref}, {session_id}, {env}, {build_sha}) are typed and shell-escaped by the runner; no other interpolation is permitted. Prefer argv where possible.

argv.description: Preferred form: argv array executed without a shell. Same placeholder rules as run. Mutually exclusive with run.

stdin.description: proposal: the structured edit proposal is fed on stdin (apply commands). Never interpolate proposal content into run/argv.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to repo root. Default: repo root.

env_allowlist.description: Env var NAMES the command may receive. Values are never written to the manifest, logs, or memory.

writes.description: Whether the command mutates state. Read commands must declare false.

paths.description: repo kind only: files/globs that hold this component's source.

read.description: Dump this component's current source-of-truth value.

rollback.description: Per-component rollback. 'git' is only valid for kind=repo. 'none' blocks Promote for edits touching this component unless accept_no_rollback is true.

accept_no_rollback.description: Explicit, user-confirmed acceptance that this component can be promoted without a rollback path.

source_ref.description: How the agent is identified in the customer's stack (name, slug, config key).

runtime_refs.description: Per-environment runtime identity (e.g. staging: VAPI assistant id). Used for trace correlation.

promote_requires.description: Required on every production: true environment.

allowed_paths.description: Paths the skill may write. ABSENT MEANS NO FILE WRITES ARE PERMITTED — required whenever any repo component uses apply mode file_patch.

approvers.description: Who may confirm promotion / manifest changes.

render_intended.description: Render the full intended runtime config from the sources (pre-deploy). Output is hashed as the intent baseline.

read_live.description: Dump the config the runtime is actually serving in {env}. Required for attestation whenever a deploy step exists.

validate.description: Dry-run / schema / rendering validation before deploy.

target_env.description: Must name a declared environment with production: false. Validated at Setup; the loop refuses a production target unconditionally.

produces.description: Identity outputs to capture: runtime_agent_id, build_sha, prompt_version…

traces.description: Fetch traces (e.g. Langfuse) for a call/session id.

runner.description: Cekura simulation runner tool name (e.g. scenarios_run_vapi_webrtc).

reset_fixtures.description: Reset/seed customer mock servers or test data before a batch.

retry_on.description: Error classes retried without counting: timeout, transport_error, mock_unavailable…

acceptable_differences.description: JSONPath/glob expressions for render-vs-live fields expected to differ (provider-assigned ids, timestamps). Anything else that differs is drift.

fields.description: Fields in call traces/metadata that carry runtime identity (e.g. assistant_id, build_sha, prompt_version).

identity_source.description: Where the expected identity value comes from for comparison.

attestation.description: How render ↔ live ↔ trace comparison is performed. Strongly recommended whenever a deploy step exists.

dir.description: Directory for session audit artifacts (hashes, diffs, eval results, pre-promotion backups). Secrets are redacted before writing.

rollback_verify.description: Post-rollback readback to confirm the old version is live again.
